name: @dexterm/classifier
description: dexterm pluggable classification models (task-1822): typed questions about a coin dossier answered with calibrated probabilities by a decision model (Kev local via llama.cpp, hosted Jev with the user's own key, JEV students via vLLM, LLM zero-shot baselines) or the always-available heuristic. Outputs are model estimates, never advice; every document goes through the prompt firewall.
author: The dexterm authors
